_about: Hand-set playbook for the prospecting engine (scripts/hq/prospects.py → hq/prospect-targets.json → IMN HQ 'Where to prospect'). One entry per brand: who to approach (segments), what we offer them, where (regions), and how much each segment is worth (weight 0-1). Organisations only, published addresses only, sending follows the warm-up ramp in IMN HQ (week 1: 5 a day in total, week 2: 10 a day in total, then up to 10 a day per brand; claude/OUTREACH.md). weeklyCap is how many new prospects Radar may find per brand per week. Edit weights or set active:false to steer the engine. Each brand has its site and outreach From address; a segment's 'page' is the page we point that kind of organisation to (Vic towns and Trade Admin trades use their own page). mailReady = the brand's domain is on the mail hub, so Radar researches prospects for it (set true when its mail setup is done).

_signals: Buying signals per brand (7 Nov 2026, Simon: 'like FCBT Radar: buying signal and rationale for engagement, tailored per brand'). Radar reads this file. Every prospect gets: FIT (who they are), TRIGGER (a dated reason to email this week, verified on their own site with its real date), GAP (what's missing or broken on their site that we fix for free), PROOF (our numbers or look-alikes who said yes), chips, a score and an opener that leads with the trigger. Score = fit 0-60 + best trigger (points if 0-8 weeks away, half if 8-10 weeks) + gaps (max 20) + proof (max 10). Triggers preferred, strong evergreen fits allowed with a lower score. Trigger 10+ weeks away or just passed with a known next date: add the prospect but snooze it until ~6 weeks before the next one (re-surfaces by itself). ask.primary 'widget' = lead with the free widget (personalised builder link), link from their resources page as the fallback; 'link' = ask for the link (and give first) until the brand has a widget.
